d: Bihar men mausam ka mijaj dhire-dhire badal raha hai. navanbar ke aakhiri dinon men subah aur rat ke tapman men giravat ke sath thand ka asar barhne laga hai. is bich mausam vibhag ne 24 navanbar ko lekar naya purvanuman jari kiya hai. iske mutabik, mangalvar ko bihar ke kisi bhi jile men barish ki sanbhavna nahin hai aur pure rajy men mausam shushk bana rah sakta hai. halanki, subah ke samay rajy ke adhikansh sthanon par halke se madhyam star ka kohra chhae rahne ki sanbhavna hai.
